items.text: **Welcome to the great Copilot Chat journey: Prompt like an expert!**

Welcome to Week 3, and get ready to unlock the full potential of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat! 
 This week we'll harness the power of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to **develop your skills and uncover valuable insights.**.

Want to see what Copilot Chat can do?
Try these prompts and get started right away. For the best experience, focus on one prompt per day and use it multiple times throughout your workday.
[✨ *Create a blog post about [topic]. Be sure to include an engaging headline and a call to action at the end.*]
[✨ *List key points from this document: [Upload file].*]
[✨ *Come up with three ideas for products merging technology and [capability], and provide a sample business plan for each.*]
[✨ *Suggest ways to add some fun and humor into [this presentation]. Give specific examples of what I might include and where these would be included in the deck: [upload presentation].*]

body.text: **Give these prompts a try this week. Next week, we'll show you how to use Copilot Chat as your thinking partner to help you make (or support) a decision!**
